exxat-pink-brand.displayName: Exxat Pink (brand literal, on navy only)

headline.purpose: Topic title in the sheet header, max 20em.

title.purpose: Part heading; inline code inside it takes the topic hue.

lede.purpose: Home lede (max 32em) and topic blurb (max 60ch), slate.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono: margin labels, crumbs, table headers, callout labels, contents heads.

number.purpose: Tabular mono counters, two digits with leading zero, in pink or the topic hue.

code.purpose: Code panel lines; inline code at 0.86em on code-sand with 3px radius.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system casts no shadows. Depth is rule weight: 2px opens, 1px separates.

rules.name: open

rules.name: separate
rules.purpose: Between rows, steps, parts, tiles; figure border; rail line.

rules.name: part
rules.purpose: Above a part and above the Next part link; the meta row on the home sheet.

rules.name: callout
rules.purpose: Left hairline of a callout in its own colour.

rules.name: head-link

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for every hover and state transition.

motion.name: ease-out

motion.name: state

motion.name: appear

motion.name: theme-toggle

motion.name: theme-crossfade

motion.purpose: Whole-page colour cross-fade when the theme changes.

motion.name: progress
motion.purpose: The 2px reading-progress line in the topic bar.

motion.name: intro-rise

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Everything above is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

narrative.overview:
Every Form Builder setting is a parameter, so the guide is set the way a parameter sheet is set: numbered, ruled, flat, and nothing boxed. The page is a warm off-white sheet under a 52px deep-navy running head. Groups open with a 2px navy rule and rows are separated by 1px hairlines; there are no cards, no containers, no shadows. Depth is rule weight alone. The reader always knows the sheet number (in the margin), the part they are on (the rail) and what comes next (the ruled Next part link).

Exxat pink is disciplined. It does two jobs only: the mono numbers and labels that index the sheet (SHEET 02, 01, PART 1 OF 12, figure numbers, step numbers) and the one filled primary pill per sheet. Every topic also owns one small hue, shown as a 10px square swatch in the contents, in the sheet label, on the rail's current mark, and on hover of links inside that topic. Inter carries the display and reading voice; JetBrains Mono carries every number, ID, URL and label. Dark mode inverts the sheet to navy and keeps every rule, weight and position unchanged.

The build deliberately refuses the category default of a dark hero over a bento of icon cards. Glows, orbs, gradient or shimmering text, floating chips, tilted mock-ups, icon tiles, pill badges, hover-lift shadows, the wave divider and the bento grid were removed and must not return.
keyCharacteristics: Flat sheet: 2px navy rule opens a group, 1px hairline separates rows, nothing boxed
Pink is an index colour (mono numbers, labels) plus one filled pill per sheet
Per-topic hue lives only in the swatch, the rail mark, in-topic headings and hover
Inter for words, JetBrains Mono (tabular) for every number, ID, label and code
Dark mode is the same sheet printed on navy; rules and layout do not move
Motion is short and settled: 200 to 250ms fades, one intro splash, nothing loops

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Pink indexes (mono numbers and labels) and fills exactly one primary pill per sheet. It is never a heading colour, a border on a box, or a background wash larger than a selection.

rules.name: The Swatch Rule
rules.body: A topic's hue appears as a 10px, 2px-radius square and as the rail's struck mark. It colours small text on hover and counters inside its own sheet; it never tints a surface.

rules.name: The Rule Weight Rule
rules.body: A 2px navy rule opens a sheet, a table, a contents list or a parts list. A 1px hairline separates rows, steps, parts and figures. There is no third weight and no box.

rules.name: The Mono Index Rule
rules.body: If it is a number, an ID, a URL, a key, a count or an uppercase label, it is JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals. Inter never carries a counter.

rules.name: The Leading-Zero Rule
rules.body: Sequence numbers are two digits (01, 02 … 12) via decimal-leading-zero, in pink or the topic hue, sitting in a 36–48px left gutter.

rules.name: The No-Box Rule
rules.body: Content is never placed in a container. If a group needs separating, open it with a rule.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow is permitted only as a flat ring (focus, the rail's current mark). Nothing casts.

dos: Do open every group (sheet header, contents, parts list, table, tool, glossary, download row) with a 2px navy rule and separate its rows with 1px hairlines.
Do set every number, ID, URL, key, count and uppercase label in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals, two-digit counters with a leading zero.
Do keep pink to mono numbers and labels plus one filled primary pill per sheet.
Do carry a topic's hue only as the 10px square swatch, the rail's current mark, in-topic counters and hover colour.

Do keep hover and state changes to 200–250ms on cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) and entrances to a 250ms fade on cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); cross-fade the theme over 400ms; disable all of it under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep dark mode the same sheet on navy: identical rules, weights and positions, pink lifted to dark-pink with navy type on the fill.
Do cap prose at 72ch, the topic column at 1060px and the page at 1500px.
donts: Don't put content in a card, panel or bordered container on the sheet; the code panel and the two navy bands are the only coloured fields.
Don't use drop shadows, hover lift, glows, drifting orbs, gradient or shimmering text, or blurred backdrops.
Don't reintroduce floating chips, tilted mock-ups, icon tiles, pill badges, the wave divider or the bento grid.
Don't colour a heading, paragraph or surface with pink or a topic hue; they index and mark, they do not fill.
Don't add a second filled pink pill to a sheet or let pink carry running text.
Don't replace masked line icons in callouts with glyph or emoji icons, or add icons to tiles and rows beyond the arrow.
Don't introduce a third rule weight, a vertical table rule or an outer table border.
